But when the appointment arrived, I showed up exactly at 4:30 PM. The staff member apologized, saying the queues in front and inside didn't match up. There were a lot of walk-ins and no doctors available. Could I reschedule?
To be honest, I was shocked and disappointed. My mother and sister are former customers here and recommended me to come here. After experiencing this, I won't be coming back.

Anyone planning to make an appointment at this clinic should think carefully.
